title: Bulbul
aiNote: This app was built with heavy AI-assisted coding. That said, great care has been taken in the quality and delivery of the final product.
description: Bulbul is a free, open-source AI voice typing app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, built solo. Hold a hotkey, speak, release, and clean text appears wherever the cursor is. Whisper handles speech-to-text and an LLM layer cleans it up based on the app you are dictating into. It runs on a bring-your-own-key setup, so there is no Bulbul-owned backend and dictation stays ephemeral. It started because existing voice typing tools were expensive, closed-source, or missing on platforms like Linux. Bulbul is launched and has crossed 500+ downloads through GitHub releases.
shortDescription: Free, open-source AI voice typing for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. Hold a hotkey, speak, release; clean text lands at your cursor. 500+ downloads.
features: System-Wide Voice Typing: Hold a hotkey, speak naturally, release, and polished text is inserted wherever the cursor is, across Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
Whisper + LLM Cleanup: Whisper for speech-to-text, then an LLM layer for contextual cleanup with app-aware formatting.
BYOK and Ephemeral by Design: Users bring their own API keys. There is no Bulbul-owned backend storing voice data, and history, dictionary and snippets live in a local SQLite file.
Built for Daily Use: Dictionary and snippet systems, text transformations, cross-platform input and text-insertion workflows, and an Android interface.
Shipped and Maintained: Documentation, deployment and release infrastructure built solo with Claude Code, 500+ downloads through GitHub releases, and users opening issues and requesting features.

description: SilkHR is a two-sided AI voice interview platform built to fix three problems with existing tools: they sound robotic, they can't handle the English-Hindi code-switching most Indian engineers actually speak, and they aren't available to candidates for practice. Recruiters build interview templates, bulk-assign candidates by email, review scored transcripts, and explicitly release results (held by default); candidates take scheduled screens in-browser or run unlimited ad-hoc mock interviews tailored to any role. The centerpiece is a streaming voice pipeline â€” Deepgram Nova-3 STT â†’ Gemini Flash â†’ Silk muga TTS â€” that drove per-turn latency from 11â€“17s down to ~2.4s by streaming on both ends and keeping clients warm across HMR.
shortDescription: Two-sided AI voice interviewer with native Hinglish, real follow-ups, and a streaming Deepgram â†’ Gemini â†’ Silk muga pipeline at ~2.4s per turn. 1st prize, Rumik Ã— AWS Voice AI Hackathon.
features: Two-Sided Platform: Recruiters build interview templates, bulk-assign candidates by email, review scored transcripts, and explicitly release results (held by default); candidates take scheduled interviews in-browser or run unlimited ad-hoc mock interviews tailored to any role.
Native Hinglish, No Toggle: Deepgram Nova-3 STT runs with language 'multi' so the interviewer handles the English-Hindi code-switching Indian engineers actually speak â€” no language switch required.
Recruiter-Grade Brain: Gemini Flash prompted to behave like an Indian recruiter â€” short conversational lines, adaptive deep follow-ups, and a pressure mode.
Emotion TTS: Silk muga streams PCM at 24kHz with first audio under a second, played gaplessly through a single shared AudioContext that schedules incoming chunks back-to-back.

Streaming Voice Pipeline: Cut per-turn latency from 11â€“17s (REST-only v1) to ~2.4s by streaming STT live, minting Silk WS tokens server-side, opening the TTS WebSocket from the browser, and keeping Mongo + model clients warm across HMR.
Release-Gated Results Flow: Templates â†’ bulk assignments â†’ sessions â†’ recruiter-released feedback, secured with httpOnly-cookie auth.

title: RobinScouts
highlight: Built for Into the Scrape-Verse, a WeMakeDevs x Bright Data hackathon.
description: RobinScouts is a hiring-change intelligence feed. Most job tools show what exists; RobinScouts shows what changed: every new posting, edited role and quietly closed listing across company career pages that are each built differently. Three custom Bright Data Scraper Studio collectors feed one normalized job schema, and the app deduplicates, diffs against the previous run and scores roles against your preferences. When a career page is redesigned and a scraper breaks, it repairs the scraper itself.
shortDescription: Hiring-change feed that tracks new, edited and closed roles across career pages, and repairs its own scrapers when pages change.
features: Change Feed: Detects new postings, edited roles and closed listings by diffing each run against the previous one.
Three Custom Collectors: Built with Bright Data Scraper Studio on three different page structures, normalized into one job schema.
Self-Healing Scrapers: When a career page is redesigned, a new collector is generated to recover the data. Demonstrated live in the demo video.
Bring Your Own Key: Paste a Bright Data API key and a careers URL to add a new company and watch a collector get built.
Source Health: A failed run shows an unhealthy-source banner and keeps serving the last known-good data.
Daily Sync: A GitHub Actions job keeps the deployed data fresh.

title: WealthPulse
description: A comprehensive investment management platform designed to help users track, analyze, and optimize their investments in mutual funds, cryptocurrencies, and other financial instruments. Built during HackCBS8.0 with AI-driven insights and real-time data.
shortDescription: AI-powered investment management platform for tracking mutual funds and crypto with real-time insights.
features: Mutual Fund Dashboard: Track and analyze mutual funds with historical NAV, risk assessment, and Monte Carlo predictions.
Cryptocurrency Dashboard: Real-time crypto price tracking, risk analysis, and AI-driven insights.
Portfolio Management: Add, remove, and track investments in mutual funds and cryptocurrencies.
AI-Powered Insights: Get AI-generated analysis and reports for your investments.
Education Hub: Curated videos and trending financial news.
Authentication: Secure login and user management via Auth0.

title: TreasuryForge
highlight: Built for the WeMakeDevs x TrueFoundry Agent Harness Hackathon.
description: TreasuryForge is an autonomous multi-asset treasury agent covering cash, BTC/ETH and a basket of NSE equities, built natively on TrueForge, TrueFoundry's open-source agent harness. The goal is not profitability but a safe decision engine: real tool use across two asset classes, generated code running in an isolated sandbox for pre-trade analysis, a native human approval gate before anything irreversible, and a self-audit sub-agent that reviews performance and proposes rule changes. Everything runs without you, and nothing executes without you.
shortDescription: Autonomous treasury agent on TrueForge with a sandboxed risk check, a human approval gate before trades, and a self-audit sub-agent.
features: Tool Use Over MCP: The agent reaches market data and trades through a registered remote MCP server.
Sandboxed Pre-Trade Analysis: Generated code runs in TrueForge's isolated sandbox to stress test risk before any trade.
Human Approval Gate: Trades pause at TrueForge's native approval checkpoint until a person approves.
Self-Audit Sub-Agent: A child agent reviews past decisions and proposes rule changes.
Full Decision Trace: A dashboard shows every decision's reasoning, a risk panel and demo triggers for the approval gate.
Market-Hours Aware: Equity trades are hard-rejected outside NSE hours.

title: Spktr
description: Spktr is a desktop AI assistant that watches your screen, answers questions about what's currently visible, and proactively alerts you when it detects notable issues like errors, failed builds, or warning prompts. It's built as a Tauri 2 desktop app with a Next.js overlay UI, a Node/Express backend, and a Rust host that manages the native window, system tray, global shortcut, and sidecar lifecycle. It captures the screen periodically, skips unchanged frames with perceptual-hash diffing, streams answers token-by-token, and layers in long-term vector memory plus per-session context so the assistant gets sharper the more you use it.
shortDescription: Desktop AI assistant (Tauri 2 + Rust) that watches your screen, answers questions about what's visible, and proactively flags errors and failed builds â€” with sqlite-vec long-term memory and per-session context.
features: Screen-Aware Q&A: Captures the screen every ~7s, skips unchanged frames via sharp-based perceptual-hash diffing, and answers questions about what's currently visible â€” streamed token-by-token to the overlay over SSE.

Proactive Engine: On meaningful screen changes (>5% pHash diff, 90s cooldown), a meta-model returns a structured { shouldIntervene, suggestion } decision and surfaces a dock toast that prefills the chat input â€” toggleable in Settings.

Long-Term Vector Memory: Extracts 1â€“3 reusable facts from every Q&A, embeds them at 768 dimensions, and retrieves the top-5 relevant memories via sqlite-vec native KNN (with automatic JS cosine fallback) to inject into every prompt.
Session Context: Tracks interactions per session (15-minute inactivity timeout), compresses them to an AI summary every 20 interactions, and injects current-session context at the top of each prompt.
Four-Layer Prompt Assembly: Each prompt is built from session context â†’ recent history (last 5 Q&A in 30 min) â†’ top-5 long-term memories â†’ current screenshot.
Pluggable Providers: An OpenAI-compatible client layer supporting Ollama and LM Studio (local) or Groq (cloud), with guided onboarding, connectivity tests, and hot-reload on config change.

Native Desktop Host: A Rust/Tauri 2 host manages the floating overlay (Ctrl+Shift+Space), system tray, and global shortcut, and launches the backend as a bundled sidecar that's killed when the app exits.
prerequisites: A model provider: Ollama, LM Studio, or Groq

title: Smart Airport Ride-Pooling Backend
description: A production-ready backend API for airport ride pooling that intelligently matches passengers into shared rides while guaranteeing zero double-bookings under high concurrency. It uses an O(n) PostGIS geospatial matching algorithm with composite scoring to minimize detours (under 30%), PostgreSQL pessimistic and optimistic locking for ACID-safe seat allocation, and multi-layer caching plus connection pooling to scale to 10,000+ concurrent users â€” load-tested at 562 req/s with 88ms average latency and a 0% error rate.
shortDescription: Production-ready Node.js + PostGIS API that pools airport rides with zero double-bookings, scaling to 10,000+ concurrent users at 562 req/s.
features: Smart Matching Algorithm: Linear O(n) scan with early termination cuts candidates by 88%, scored on a composite of detour (50%), distance (30%), and capacity (20%) to keep shared-ride detours under 30%.
Zero Double-Bookings: Pessimistic locking via SELECT FOR UPDATE plus optimistic version-field locking inside ACID transactions eliminates race conditions under concurrent load.
High Concurrency: Scales to 10,000+ concurrent users â€” load-tested at 562 req/s with 88ms average latency, 209ms P99, and a 0% error rate.
Performance Optimization: Multi-layer caching (70% query reduction), connection pooling (7x speedup), and B-Tree/composite indexing (10â€“100x faster queries).
Geospatial Matching: PostGIS-powered geographic queries with a 10km search radius and GIST spatial indexing on cab locations.
Dynamic Pricing: Distance-based fare (â‚¹50 base + â‚¹10/km) with pooling discounts for shared rides and a Redis-ready surge-pricing framework.
Production-Ready Infrastructure: Dockerized with Docker Compose, an autocannon load-testing suite, schema migration and seed scripts, and a Postman API collection.

title: JobBoard AI
description: A conversational, AI-driven job aggregator that turns "find me remote Python internships" into a ranked shortlist of real openings. Instead of filling out search forms across a dozen job sites, users just chat â€” an LLM parses the request into structured intent, the backend fans out concurrent fetchers across 6+ job boards, cross-source duplicates are collapsed, and every result is scored by an LLM against the user's actual preferences, surfacing the best matches with per-dimension reasoning.
shortDescription: Conversational AI job search â€” describe what you want in plain English and an LLM pipeline fetches across 6+ boards, then deduplicates, scores, and ranks the best matches.
features: Natural-Language Search: An LLM (Llama 3.3 70B via Groq) parses free-form queries into structured intent â€” role, tech stack, seniority, and location â€” so users find jobs by chatting instead of filling out forms.
